title: CSV Viewer & CSV Editor
description: CSV viewer and CSV editor for big files: CSV, TSV and PSV as a fast table. Edit cells and save, sort, filter, column stats, delimiter and encoding detection. Works offline. Zovo Pro: compare CSV files, SQL on CSV, export to Excel, JSON or Parquet.

title: EngineNear - Cut Token Costs & Fix Prompts
description: Never waste tokens on bad prompts. Auto-structures your questions for sharper AI answers and prevents credential leaks

title: DuckDB Viewer & SQL Editor
description: DuckDB viewer and SQL editor: open .duckdb files read-only, browse schemas and tables, sort and filter rows, and run SQL on DuckDB, CSV, Parquet and JSON files. DuckDB is built in. Offline, no install.

title: BPMN Diagram Editor & Viewer
description: BPMN editor and viewer for VS Code: open .bpmn files as a diagram, edit pools, lanes, tasks and gateways, and save standard BPMN 2.0 that keeps Camunda, Zeebe and Flowable attributes. Offline, no account.

title: WebAssembly Viewer (WASM, WAT)
description: WebAssembly viewer for .wasm files: readable WAT text with folding per function, a module overview of sections, imports, exports and sizes, and WAT to WASM and WASM to WAT conversion with errors and line numbers. Offline, no toolchain to install.

title: HEIC Viewer & AVIF Viewer
description: HEIC viewer for VS Code that also opens HEIF and AVIF photos: zoom, pan, every image of burst and multi-image files, bit depth, EXIF camera data and the GPS position as plain numbers. Offline, nothing to install.

title: Lottie Viewer & Lottie Player
description: Lottie viewer and player for Lottie JSON (Bodymovin) and .lottie files: play, pause, loop, speed and a frame scrubber, layers, markers and missing-image warnings. Offline, no account, no network calls.

title: TGA Viewer & DDS, KTX Textures
description: TGA viewer for VS Code that also opens DDS, KTX and KTX2 textures: mip levels, cube faces, array layers, BC1 to BC7 and ETC2 decoding, zoom, texel grid, color under the cursor and alpha on a checker. Offline, no tools to install.

title: Synk
description: Zero-friction environment setup for Node.js and Python projects — detects, installs, and records everything automatically.
